source.evidence: Manual inspection of the volume title, Greek work headings and explicit endings. Printed odd pages put Greek in the left column, even pages in the right. Scan 60 is blank with show-through; its repeated ἡμῖν OCR has no printed source. Gaudentius scan leaves 458-463 repeat 452-457. Aristides leaves 614-619 repeat 608-613 and 650-655 repeat 644-649. The Greek text ends at scan 700 (printed164); scan701 begins Martianus Capella's Latin text. Modern prefatory matter and Meibom's notes are not the ancient authors' text.
source.title: Antiquae musicae auctores septem, Graece et Latine (Meibom 1652)
